pairs: Ecce ego suscitabo super Babylonem et super habitatores ejus,
“Behold, I will raise up, over Babylon and over its inhabitants,
qui cor suum levaverunt contra me,
who have lifted up their heart against me,
And I will send winnowers into Babylon,
and they will demolish her land.
quoniam venerunt super eam undique in die afflictionis ejus.
For they will overwhelm her from every side in the day of her affliction.
Non tendat qui tendit arcum suum,
Let him who draws the bow, not draw his bow.
And let him who wears armor,
not rise up. Do not spare her young men.
Et cadent interfecti in terra Chaldæorum,
And the slain will fall in the land of the Chaldeans,
and the wounded in its regions.
Quoniam non fuit viduatus Israël et Juda a Deo suo,
Yet Israel and Judah have not been widowed by their God,
terra autem eorum repleta est delicto a Sancto Israël.
though their land has been filled with transgression against the Holy One of Israel.
Flee from the midst of Babylon!
And let each one save his own life.
Do not be silent about her iniquity.
quoniam tempus ultionis est a Domino:
For it is the time of revenge from the Lord.
He himself will repay her, in her turn.
Calix aureus Babylon in manu Domini,
Babylon is a gold cup in the hand of the Lord,
The nations have drunk from her wine,
Babylon has fallen and been crushed.
Take a balm to her pain,
if perhaps she may be healed.”
et eamus unusquisque in terram suam:
and let each one of us go to his own land.
quoniam pervenit usque ad cælos judicium ejus,
For her judgment has reached even to the heavens,
et elevatum est usque ad nubes.
and has been lifted up even to the clouds.
The Lord has brought forth our justices.
et narremus in Sion opus Domini Dei nostri.
and let us describe in Zion the work of the Lord our God.”
implete pharetras: suscitavit Dominus spiritum regum Medorum:
fill the quivers. The Lord has raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes.
et contra Babylonem mens ejus est ut perdat eam,
And his mind is against Babylon, so that he may destroy her.
For this is the vengeance of the Lord,
Upon the walls of Babylon, lift up a sign.
quia cogitavit Dominus, et fecit quæcumque locutus est contra habitatores Babylonis.
For the Lord has planned and has accomplished all that he has spoken, against the inhabitants of Babylon.
You who live above many waters,
your measure has been cut short.
Juravit Dominus exercituum per animam suam:
The Lord of hosts has sworn by himself, saying:
Quoniam replebo te hominibus quasi brucho,
“For I will fill you with men as with locusts,
and they will sing a rhythmic chant against you.”
Qui fecit terram in fortitudine sua,
The One who made the earth by his strength,
who prepared the world by his wisdom,
and who stretched out the heavens by his prudence:
the waters will be multiplied in the heavens.
qui levat nubes ab extremo terræ,
The One who lifts up the clouds from the ends of the earth:
he has turned lightning into rain,
et produxit ventum de thesauris suis.
and he has brought forth wind from his storehouses.
Stultus factus est omnis homo a scientia;
Each man has become foolish before his own knowledge.
confusus est omnis conflator in sculptili:
Each sculptor has been confounded by his own sculpture.
For what he has formed of them is a lie,
and there is no spirit in them.
In the time of their visitation, they will perish.
The portion of Jacob is not like their portion.
quia qui fecit omnia ipse est:
For the One who made all things is his portion,
and Israel is the scepter of his inheritance.
The Lord of hosts is his name:
“For me, you strike together the instruments of war;
et ego collidam in te gentes,
and with you, I will strike together nations;
and with you, I will scatter the kingdoms.
I will strike together the horse and his rider;
I will strike together the chariot and its rider.
I will strike together man and woman;
I will strike together the old man and the boy;
I will strike together the young man and the virgin.
I will strike together the pastor and his flock;
I will strike together the farmer and his yoke of oxen;
I will strike together military leaders and civil leaders.
et reddam Babyloni, et cunctis habitatoribus Chaldææ, omne malum suum quod fecerunt in Sion,
And I will repay Babylon and all the inhabitants of Chaldea for all their evil that they have done in Zion,
for you are corrupting the entire earth.
et extendam manum meam super te, et evolvam te de petris,
And I will extend my hand over you, and I will roll you down from the rocks,
et dabo te in montem combustionis:
and I will make you into a burning mountain.
et non tollent de te lapidem in angulum,
And they will not take from you a stone for the corner,
nor a stone for the foundations.
Instead, you will be destroyed unto eternity,”
Lift up a sign in the land!
Sound the trumpet among the nations!
Announce against her the kings of Ararat,
Lead in the horse, like the stinging locust.
and the entire land under their authority.
And the earth will be shaken and will be disturbed.
quia evigilabit contra Babylonem cogitatio Domini,
For the plan of the Lord against Babylon will awaken,
ut ponat terram Babylonis desertam et inhabitabilem.
so that he may make the land of Babylon desolate and uninhabitable.
The strong ones of Babylon have ceased to do battle.
and they have become like women.
Her tabernacles have been set ablaze;
Runner will go forth to meet runner,
ut annuntiet regi Babylonis quia capta est civitas ejus a summo usque ad summum.
so as to tell the king of Babylon that his city has been captured, from one end to the other,
and that the fords were seized in advance,
and that the marshes have been burned with fire,
and that the men of war have been set in disarray.
For thus says the Lord of hosts,
“The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor.
This is the time of her threshing.
and the time of her harvest will arrive.”
the king of Babylon, has consumed me, has devoured me.
He has made me like an empty vessel.
He has swallowed me like a dragon.
replevit ventrem suum teneritudine mea, et ejecit me.
He has filled his belly with my tender ones, and he has cast me out.
and so my flesh is upon Babylon,”
et sanguis meus super habitatores Chaldææ,
“And my blood is upon the inhabitants of Chaldea,”
Because of this, thus says the Lord:
and I will avenge your vengeance,
and I will make her sea into a desert,
and I will dry up her spring.
And Babylon will become a tumult,
They will roar together, like lions,
they will shake their manes, like young lions.
In calore eorum ponam potus eorum,
In their heat, I will give them a drink,
and I will inebriate them, so that they become drowsy,
Deducam eos quasi agnos ad victimam,
I will lead them away, like lambs to the slaughter,
and like rams with young goats.
et comprehensa est inclyta universæ terræ!
and how was the renowned one of all the earth seized?
quomodo facta est in stuporem Babylon inter gentes!
How has Babylon become an astonishment among the nations?
The sea has ascended over Babylon;
she has been covered by the multitude of its waves.
Factæ sunt civitates ejus in stuporem,
Her cities have become an astonishment,
a land in which no one may live,
nec transeat per eam filius hominis.
nor may a son of man pass through it.
Et visitabo super Bel in Babylone,
And I will visit against Bel in Babylon,
et ejiciam quod absorbuerat de ore ejus:
and I will cast from his mouth what he has swallowed.
et non confluent ad eum ultra gentes,
And the nations will no longer flow together before him.
For even the wall of Babylon will also fall.
ut salvet unusquisque animam suam ab ira furoris Domini,
so that each one may save his life from the wrath of the fury of the Lord.
et ne forte mollescat cor vestrum,
For otherwise, your heart may faint,
et timeatis auditum qui audietur in terra:
and you may be afraid at the news that is heard in the land.
And the news will arrive within a year,
and after that year more news will arrive.
And iniquity will be in the land,
and one ruler will be over another ruler.
Because of this, behold, the days are approaching,
when I will visit against the graven images of Babylon.
And her entire land will be confounded,
et universi interfecti ejus cadent in medio ejus.
and all her slain will fall in her midst.
And the heavens and the earth,
and all the things that are in them,
et omnia quæ in eis sunt:
quia ab aquilone venient ei prædones,
For despoilers will approach her from the north,
Et quomodo fecit Babylon, ut caderent occisi in Israël,
And in the manner that Babylon has caused the slain to fall in Israel,
sic de Babylone cadent occisi in universa terra.
so the slain of Babylon will fall over the entire earth.
You who have fled from the sword,
et Jerusalem ascendat super cor vestrum.
and let Jerusalem rise up in your heart.
quia venerunt alieni super sanctificationem domus Domini.
for strangers have overwhelmed the holiness of the house of the Lord.
Because of this, behold, the days are approaching,
when I will visit against her graven images,
et in omni terra ejus mugiet vulneratus.
and within all her land the wounded will groan.
If Babylon were to ascend to heaven,
et firmaverit in excelso robur suum,
and establish her strength on high,
her despoilers would go forth from me,
A voice of outcry from Babylon,
et contritio magna de terra Chaldæorum:
and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!
For the Lord has despoiled Babylon,
et perdidit ex ea vocem magnam:
and he has perished the great voice from her.
et sonabunt fluctus eorum quasi aquæ multæ;
And their wave will make a sound like many waters.
Their voice has uttered a noise.
quia venit super eam, id est super Babylonem,
For the despoiler has overwhelmed her, that is,
and her strong ones have been apprehended,
and their bow has been weakened.
quia fortis ultor Dominus reddens retribuet.
For the Lord, the powerful revenger, will certainly repay.
et sapientes ejus, et duces ejus,
and her wise ones, and her military rulers,
And they will sleep an everlasting sleep,
says the King: the Lord of hosts is his name.
Thus says the Lord of hosts:
Murus Babylonis ille latissimus suffossione suffodietur,
“That very wide wall of Babylon will be utterly overturned,
et portæ ejus excelsæ igni comburentur,
and her exalted gates will be burned with fire,
and the labors of the people will be as nothing,
and the labors of the nations will be sent into the fire
Verbum quod præcepit Jeremias propheta Saraiæ filio Neriæ filii Maasiæ,
The word that Jeremiah, the prophet, instructed to Seraiah,
cum pergeret cum Sedecia rege in Babylonem,
the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he traveled with king Zedekiah into Babylon,
in the fourth year of his reign.
Now Seraiah was the leader of the prophets.
Et scripsit Jeremias omne malum quod venturum erat super Babylonem, in libro uno:
And Jeremiah wrote in one book all the evil that was to overwhelm Babylon;
omnia verba hæc quæ scripta sunt contra Babylonem.
all these words were written against Babylon.
tu locutus es contra locum istum,
you have spoken against this place so that you may destroy it,
so that there would not be anyone,
ne sit qui in eo habitet,
and so that it may be desolate forever.’
And when you will have completed reading this book,
you will tie a stone to it,
et projicies illum in medium Euphraten,
and you will cast it into the midst of the Euphrates.
et non consurget a facie afflictionis quam ego adduco super eam,
And she will not rise up before the face of the affliction that I will lead over her.
The words of Jeremiah thus far.
